findings.detail: Distributed codebook initialization enters mismatched collectives. Only rank 0 calls raw_module.init_codebook(), but VQLayer.init_codebook() calls distributed.broadcast() whenever a process group is initialized. The other ranks skip initialization and reach the explicit barrier at train_rqvae.py:310. Rank 0 waits in broadcast while the remaining ranks wait in barrier, so the four-rank launcher cannot proceed into training.
findings.reproduction: Run the actual trainer with its four-process torchrun launcher and a valid input dataset. At the initialization section, rank 0 enters the broadcast in model/layers.py:143; ranks 1-3 enter dist.barrier() in train_rqvae.py:310. The collective mismatch hangs before the first training batch.
findings.correction: Make all ranks call init_codebook in the same order so they participate in each broadcast, or make initialization rank-0-only without an internal broadcast and explicitly broadcast the initialized codebook parameters to other ranks using matching collectives. Then verify a complete multi-rank startup and at least one train step.
